{{Quote|My partner in history is traveling to Dathomir. I wish him well and safety.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL1">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (1/8)}}</ref>}}
'''Pisk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Pisk and his friend [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]], a retired [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] agent, decided to dedicate to history and [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] of the galaxy. While x'Rilsam wandered to many worlds, Pisk preferred to focus first on one planet: [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Both planed to meet up at the [[Cheapside Cantina|cantina]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] after their explorations had been drawn to a close.<ref name="SWG:AEL2" />
